findings.highlight: taken to a place like this
findings.evidenceJa: このような場所に監禁される
findings.governingReading: Saber rebukes Shirou for being easily abducted by Illya and confined in a place like this.
findings.explanation: Taken to omits his imprisonment, weakening the basis of Saber’s anger.

findings.evidenceJa: マスター失格
findings.governingReading: Saber calls Shirou a failure or unfit as a Master because of his conduct.
findings.explanation: Disqualified suggests a formal removal of status rather than her personal judgment of his fitness.

findings.evidenceJa: きっぱりと言い放つ
findings.governingReading: Saber states her duty firmly and decisively.
findings.explanation: Speaks clearly removes the forceful finality of her answer.

findings.evidenceJa: 勝手な思いこみ
findings.governingReading: Shirou acknowledges that his relief rests on a self-serving assumption about Saber.
findings.explanation: Prejudice adds hostile or discriminatory connotations absent from 思いこみ.

findings.highlight: Saber is meant to act like this
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーはこうでなくちゃいけない
findings.governingReading: Shirou feels that Saber has to be this way: firm and recognizably herself.
findings.explanation: Act like this narrows his emotional recognition of who she is to outward behavior.

findings.evidenceJa: 本当に実像として、そこにいらっしゃるのでしょうか
findings.governingReading: Shirou comically wonders, in exaggeratedly polite language, whether Rin is truly present as a real image.
findings.explanation: The English drops the real-image wording and mock-formal register that carry the joke.

findings.evidenceJa: 出向く必要もなかった
findings.governingReading: Rin says perhaps there was no need for them to come all this way.
findings.explanation: The infinitive marker is missing, producing an overt grammar error.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分だけは生き延びる
findings.governingReading: Archer says this kind of man burdens everyone around him yet alone manages to survive.
findings.explanation: The English omits だけ and loses the barb that Shirou survives while others bear the cost.

findings.highlight: went out intending to kill them
findings.evidenceJa: 殺す、と宣言して出ていった
findings.governingReading: Illya left after explicitly declaring that she would kill Rin and Archer.
findings.explanation: Intending removes the spoken declaration on which Shirou bases his inference.

findings.evidenceJa: 助かった
findings.governingReading: Shirou reacts with relief that Rin and Illya apparently missed one another.
findings.explanation: That’s okay expresses acceptance rather than relief at avoiding the fight.

findings.highlight: you would have ended up fighting her
findings.evidenceJa: 俺たちは
findings.governingReading: Shirou says that without their rescue, he and Saber would have ended up fighting Illya.
findings.explanation: You shifts the prospective fight from Shirou’s party to Rin and Archer.

findings.highlight: wouldn’t have come in like this
findings.evidenceJa: こんなところまで忍び込まない
findings.governingReading: Rin says they would not have infiltrated this far into the castle without confirming Illya and Berserker had left.
findings.explanation: Come in omits the stealth and depth of the infiltration.

findings.evidenceJa: あいかわらず強気
findings.governingReading: Shirou regards Rin as characteristically bold or aggressive, and this time her nerve proved fortunate.
findings.explanation: Direct changes risk-taking boldness into communicative straightforwardness.

findings.evidenceJa: 息が止まる
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese proceeds directly from Shirou’s exclamation to his rejection of Saber’s self-sacrifice; two shock-reaction lines are commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores the deleted breath-stopping and “what is that?” reactions as active narration.

findings.evidenceJa: 損なコトばっかり考える
findings.governingReading: Shirou angrily asks why Saber always thinks in ways that put herself at a loss.
findings.explanation: The English first gives an abstract unfavorable-things rendering and then prints a competing “stupid things” rewrite, losing the recurring self-sacrificial pattern.

findings.highlight: only Saber knew where you were
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーじゃないとアンタの居場所は判らなかった
findings.governingReading: Rin could not have determined Shirou’s location without Saber.
findings.explanation: Only Saber knew implies she already possessed the location, obscuring her role as the means of tracking him.

findings.evidenceJa: 口喧嘩も結構だが
findings.governingReading: Archer tells them that is enough quarreling for now.
findings.explanation: Disputes are good reverses the idiom into apparent approval of the argument.

findings.highlight: It’s fine if I bear with it
findings.evidenceJa: 我慢すれば持ちこたえられる程度
findings.governingReading: Shirou says the condition is only at a level he can hold out against if he endures it.
findings.explanation: It’s fine suppresses the strain and turns endurance into evidence of harmlessness.

findings.highlight: things are going too fast for you to grasp the situation
findings.evidenceJa: 突然の事で状況が掴めない
findings.governingReading: Saber recognizes that the sudden turn of events may leave Shirou unable to grasp the situation.
findings.explanation: Going too fast replaces suddenness with ongoing pace.

findings.evidenceJa: 懸命に体を動かした
findings.governingReading: Shirou moves his injured body with desperate effort.
findings.explanation: Earnestly is nonidiomatic for physical exertion and weakens the severity of the effort.

findings.highlight: So as a man, I can’t show weakness now
findings.evidenceJa: 男として、ここでそんな姿を見せられない
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese ends after noting that Saber came despite her weakened body; the masculine-pride explanation is commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores deleted gendered bravado and assigns Shirou an explicit motive absent from the active witness.

findings.highlight: As soon as we leave the room, I gasp.
findings.evidenceJa: 部屋から出た途端、思わずそんな声が漏れた
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese moves from Shirou’s exclamation directly to identifying the hallway; the explanatory reaction is commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores a deleted narration line as active text.

findings.evidenceJa: 一面樹海
findings.governingReading: Rin warns that beyond the castle an unbroken sea of trees spreads in every direction.
findings.explanation: Big forest removes both the dense 樹海 image and the sense that it covers the whole exterior.

findings.evidenceJa: あの樹海
findings.governingReading: Shirou identifies the particular sea of trees said to lie hours by car from Miyama.
findings.explanation: Forest again removes the trackless, enveloping character of 樹海.

findings.evidenceJa: もっと日数が経っていた
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders whether more days, rather than merely half a day, may have passed.
findings.explanation: Longer leaves the unit unspecified and loses his fear that multiple days elapsed.

findings.evidenceJa: 形の上ではまる一日
findings.governingReading: Although only half a day has elapsed, Saber says that because the date changed it counts formally as a whole day of captivity.
findings.explanation: Captured for a day now converts the calendar-form distinction into elapsed duration and contradicts the preceding sentence.

findings.highlight: you would not have been yourself.
findings.evidenceJa: シロウではなくなっていたでしょう
findings.governingReading: Saber’s speech ends after saying Shirou would no longer have been himself.
findings.explanation: The English never closes the quotation, obscuring the speech boundary.

findings.highlight: It is not like I did not consider that possibility
findings.evidenceJa: 私とて、その可能性を考慮しなかった訳ではありません
findings.governingReading: Saber continues in direct speech, admitting she considered the possibility of his death.
findings.explanation: The English has a closing quotation but no opening mark, producing a broken dialogue boundary.

findings.highlight: Saber says so with a faint smile.
findings.evidenceJa: 淡い笑顔でセイバーはそんな事を言う
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese begins with Shirou sharing Saber’s concern; her faint-smile narration is commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores a deleted expression and makes Saber’s emotional presentation more explicit.

findings.highlight: Every step brings unpleasantness and pain as if boiling water is pouring into my veins.
findings.evidenceJa: 血管に熱湯を流し込まれるような痛みと不快感
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese states only that his body hurts but he can run by gritting his teeth; the boiling-water comparison is commented out.
findings.explanation: mirror moon restores a deleted, much more graphic description of Shirou’s pain.

findings.evidenceJa: 体は痛むが
findings.governingReading: His body hurts, but he can manage to run if he grits his teeth.
findings.explanation: The English prints two abandoned starts before completing the sentence.

findings.evidenceJa: 肩を貸そうか
findings.governingReading: Shirou almost offers Saber his shoulder for physical support.
findings.explanation: Needs a hand generalizes the specific bodily assistance that would provoke her refusal.

findings.evidenceJa: 階段を下りていく
findings.governingReading: Rin goes down the stairs while urging the others onward.
findings.explanation: Runs adds speed to her movement that the source does not state.

findings.evidenceJa: 国道
findings.governingReading: Rin hopes to reach the national highway under cover of darkness.
findings.explanation: Main road removes the specific route type used to orient their escape.

findings.evidenceJa: 呆れた事に
findings.governingReading: Shirou is exasperated or incredulous that the interior passage alone runs roughly thirty meters.
findings.explanation: Amazing turns his weary disbelief at the castle’s scale into positive admiration.

findings.evidenceJa: くすくすという忍び笑い
findings.governingReading: Illya’s concealed voice rings out with a suppressed, furtive giggle.
findings.explanation: Faint describes volume but removes the stealthy, knowing quality of the laugh.

findings.highlight: if I turn my back on it again
findings.evidenceJa: 背中を向ければ殺される
findings.governingReading: Once they recognize the enemy, everyone understands that showing their backs means death.
findings.explanation: Again invents a previous act of turning their backs after recognizing the enemy and muddles the instantaneous tactical realization.

findings.highlight: As I can feel the Servant’s strength now
findings.evidenceJa: サーヴァントの力が判る今
findings.governingReading: Now that Shirou understands Servants’ power, he can comprehend the scale of Berserker.
findings.explanation: Feel reframes accumulated understanding as a present sensory detection ability.

findings.evidenceJa: 愉しげに弾んでいる
findings.governingReading: Illya’s voice bounces with delighted enjoyment as she welcomes Rin into the trap.
findings.explanation: Cheerful gives a generic mood and removes the lively pleasure she takes in the situation.

findings.evidenceJa: 捕まえた昆虫を串刺しにする
findings.governingReading: Her smile exposes the innocent, merciless impulse of a child impaling an insect she has caught.
findings.explanation: Kill generalizes the act and removes the concrete impalement image that defines Illya’s cruelty.

findings.highlight: Innocent and merciless emotion that will kill
findings.evidenceJa: 無邪気で無慈悲な裸の感情
findings.governingReading: The smile is naked emotion, innocent and merciless, likened to impaling a captured insect.
findings.explanation: The English leaves a subjectless fragment in which “emotion” appears to kill insects.

findings.evidenceJa: これで詰めだ
findings.governingReading: Berserker’s repositioning places the escape party in checkmate.
findings.explanation: Done for conveys doom but removes the tactical checkmate metaphor; “now” also risks sounding temporary.

findings.evidenceJa: 無駄死にと知りながらも
findings.governingReading: Their only remaining path is to challenge the mass of death despite knowing they will die in vain.
findings.explanation: Pointless omits the explicit death that makes the choice more than a futile attempt.

findings.evidenceJa: 理性を一時的に解放され
findings.governingReading: Illya temporarily releases Berserker’s reason so that he consciously recognizes the enemies before him.
findings.explanation: The English omits the temporary limit and leaves the degree and duration of his restored reason unbounded.

findings.highlight: Her voice is cold, killing her emotions.
findings.evidenceJa: 感情を殺した声
findings.governingReading: Rin continues in a cold voice from which she has suppressed all emotion.
findings.explanation: The English makes the voice itself kill her emotions and presents the suppression as an ongoing action.

findings.evidenceJa: 僅かに頷く
findings.governingReading: After considering Berserker, Archer gives a slight nod.
findings.explanation: Quietly changes the small degree of the nod into its sound or manner.

findings.evidenceJa: あんがいかわいいトコある
findings.governingReading: Illya mocks Rin for having an unexpectedly cute side in relying on an unidentified Servant.
findings.explanation: The English omits that this quality surprises Illya, weakening the taunt’s character judgment.

findings.evidenceJa: とんでもない事
findings.governingReading: Archer voices an outrageous proposition: that he may defeat Berserker rather than merely delay him.
findings.explanation: Unexpected removes the judgment that the claim is wildly beyond reason in this situation.

findings.evidenceJa: アーチャー、アンタ
findings.governingReading: Rin begins an interrupted “Archer, you—” in disbelief.
findings.explanation: The English drops アンタ and supplies neither continuation punctuation nor a closing quotation mark.

findings.evidenceJa: 手の届かない場所
findings.governingReading: The lobby has already become a place beyond Shirou’s reach when he turns back.
findings.explanation: Far away retains distance but loses the immediate inability to reach or intervene.

findings.evidenceJa: 短剣が握られていた
findings.governingReading: A short sword or dagger has appeared in Archer’s previously empty hand.
findings.explanation: That supplies a prior shared reference the scene has not introduced, weakening the sudden manifestation.
